ModMetaData.name: Barren Sand
ModMetaData.author: Faeris
ModMetaData.description:
Sand stays bare. Tall grass and fungus of every kind - cave fungi, boomshrooms, light-resistant mushrooms, the mushrooms mods add - no longer grow, spread or get sown on sand, soft sand and the sand variants mods add.
Everything else keeps growing on sand as before: cacti, desert flowers, short grass, crops.
On every map load it also removes the tall grass and fungus already standing on sand, so an existing colony is cleaned up the first time it loads.
The plant and sand lists are worked out from the loaded defs at startup and written to the log, so mod-added plants and sand terrains are covered.
Requires Harmony.
